catalogue_requests.reason: no catalogue class stops an incubator's temperature control and CO2 flow paths; cap.sample.incubate.v1 is a long sample hold and cap.motion.stop.v1 is for motion, so the package uses an x-cap id with an inline output schema and binds it as the safe_state action
catalogue_requests.summary: Stop temperature control and both CO2 flow paths (the safe state).

notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check with evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level. This package models the INHECO SCILA CO2 incubator only; the ODTC thermal cycler, the finders, the FTP downloaders, the raw XML configuration methods and the door/position commands are NOT COVERED. The only writable state field is the boolean auto_boost_co2; temperature control is enabled only by the bounded cap.thermal.setpoint.v1 action, so an agent cannot enable heating without a bounded target temperature. The clone states no temperature unit and no numeric temperature range: the temperature reads and the two catalogue temperature actions use the catalogue's Cel unit and pass the wrapper's number through unchanged, and target_temperature is Limit.operator_required until the site overlay supplies a range (site-limits.example.json is only an example). The hardware path (native.py) was never run; the fake is an in-memory object with placeholder values, not a recording. Model-authored and unreviewed (driver.lock.json reviewed_by is null): the loader refuses this R2 package's hardware backend until a human sets reviewed_by, and nothing here claims a hardware run or a human review. gate.digest is the digest the check printed; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
